alokacia.rozhodnutie: Owner decision 2026-11-13: close events-v3-20261108 with its 45 accepted sessions and evaluate them without further collection. The rejected session stays archived with its verdict; sessions 47 and 48 were never captured. No new campaign: a fix of the process-list walk in guestparse would change extractor_sha256, so the bundle server-v2-benign-v6 and the audits of corpus benign-v6 would no longer match. Groups 1 to 7 are complete (6 scenarios each), group 8 has 3 of its 6 sessions; nothing is redistributed.

calibration.event_definition: k of n after n scored targets; rising edges; reset at barriers
calibration.exposure_definition: scored targets times nominal interval; warmup/gaps excluded
calibration.note: Calibration frequency is not a held-out false-alarm measurement or guarantee.

values.poznamka: Prevadzkove udalosti su benigne; kazdy alarm je falosny. Vysledok plati iba pre tieto typy udalosti v labe a nehovori nic o detekcii utokov ani malveru (HONESTY P4).
predpoklady: obojstranny exaktny Garwoodov interval s alfa/2 na kazdu stranu; pri 0 udalostiach je horna hranica -ln(alfa/2) udalosti
odhaduje sa miera vazena expoziciou tychto relacii; udalosti v relacii sa beru ako nezavisle (pravidlo k z n ich moze zhlukovat, casy udalosti su pri relaciach)
variabilita medzi bootmi v intervale nie je; jednotkou neistoty je skupina (METODIKA kap. 1), pocet skupin je vo vysledku
intervaly po scenaroch a skupinach nie su simultanne
okno patri udalosti, ked sa jeho snimky [t - (W-1)*perioda, t] prekryvaju s intervalom udalosti [host start, host stop hotovy]; cas udalosti obsahuje aj prechod (METODIKA kap. 3, znacka transition)
dozvuk je 300 s po poslednom okne, ktore udalost obsahovalo; mimo udalosti a dozvuku je cista prevadzka
udalost bez dokazu (executed false) a jej okna do metrik nevstupuju (NAVRH_PROTOKOL_V3 kap. 5)
porovnanie s cistou prevadzkou je podmieneny exaktny binomicky test dvoch Poissonovych mier (jednostranne: viac alarmov pri udalosti); relacie a boot nie su v teste zohladnene
